name: sre-hamali-management
description: Deploy entrypoint only. Real code lives in backend/ and frontend/ — Railway (via Nixpacks) auto-detects this package.json at the repo root and runs these two scripts.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.start: npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm --prefix backend run start
